methodology.selection: evenly spaced chronological holdout row indices, including first and last; no outcome-based selection
methodology.execution: sequential local restored HydraDB reads, same ranker and learned memory, no training or graph writes
methodology.scope: direct serving functions, not HTTP transport; this does not certify production database parity
methodology.cache: benchmark ticket-vector cache cleared for each sampled row; serving uses ticket 0
methodology.timing: one pass, not a load test; shared process caches can favor later calls
methodology.input: benchmark uses summary plus description; serving receives their 4000-character text stripped, as the HTTP handler does
